family: G_N=family.evaluate on all N actual bits, with NEW minimum-source-certificate selection over original guarded plans. Uniform P program family.py; empty-witness NP verifier proof.md. Ties first, fallback output0 and t_N=u_N=d_plan=N+1.
theorem: For each old-guard accepted candidate p, define original geometry dimension d(p)=1+C(Q-1), actual same-map primitive entropies Theta_j,Hsrc_j and scalar recurrence (SEL1). source_certificate computes u(p)=min(d(p),c_H+1+(S-1)(C-1)) with S=Dtot+max(Y_s0,max_j Theta_j+1)+3. The controller selects least u(p). At its selected plan t_N is the exact POS/DP threshold and d_plan=d(p); t_N<=u_N<=d_plan. These values are uniformly polynomial-time computable from N. C_B2(G_N)>=4N-8t_N+8>=4N-8u_N+8 holds for EVERY integer N>=0. At EVERY sufficiently large integer length u_N<=2^ceil(D_sel Z), D_sel=22045317/5000000=4.4090634, Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)), L=ceil(log2 N), B=ceil(log2(L+1)). Also limsup log2(u_N)/Z<=Cstar6<=440906378851/100000000000, Cstar6=inf_(S6)(w0+X) for the original S6 defined in proof.md. For each fixed real epsilon>0, C_B2(G_N)>=4N-N^epsilon at ALL sufficiently large integer lengths, and this SAME new fixed family has liminf C_B2(G_N)/N>=4. The new family need not equal the original minimum-geometry family.
